subject: Private deployment: next steps and network confirmation (LedgerAI)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@ledgerai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment: next steps and network confirmation (LedgerAI)

Hi Sam — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can line up engineering and procurement next week.

TL;DR: LedgerAI is leaning toward a Private deployment (Private VPC with PrivateLink endpoint). To scope the onboarding and slot a delivery window we need the network details below and a point of contact for NetOps.

Summary of decisions on the call:
- Deployment mode: Private VPC via PrivateLink (preferred for least outbound exposure)
- Data: No on-prem storage required; all inference in customer VPC
- Timeline: target pilot in January (tentative)

Action items / asks from LedgerAI (please confirm):
1) Confirm PrivateLink is the chosen connectivity pattern (vs VPC peering). If peering is required, tell us why.
2) Provide the NetOps contact and an egress IP allowlist contact so we can supply exact IPs and ports.
3) Share any firewall/proxy constraints (TLS interception, proxy auth).
4) Procurement: anticipated PO/contract cadence and any required vendor forms (W-9, SOW template).

Next steps from our side:
- I attached our "redwood_privatenet_quickstart.pdf" and an "ledgerai_ip_allowlist_template.csv" you can drop into your NetOps ticket.
- Vivek will propose a 30-minute technical kickoff to confirm ports, TLS, and cert exchange.
- Marissa will coordinate onboarding and share our SOC2 and data retention FAQ for compliance review.

Can you confirm (1)-(3) and share expected procurement lead-time? If you prefer, send your procurement and security contacts and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks — Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_privatenet_quickstart.pdf (guide, 4 pages); ledgerai_ip_allowlist_template.csv (CSV template)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@ledgerai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@ledgerai.com, procure@ledgerai.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment: next steps and network confirmation (LedgerAI)

Thanks Kimberly — good summary. Confirming a few points from LedgerAI:

1) Connectivity: LedgerAI prefers PrivateLink (we want the less intrusive model on our side). Our security team flagged that peering would require additional routing reviews and cross-account IAM exceptions.

2) NetOps contact: Jordan Patel (jordan.patel@ledgerai.com). He handles firewall allowlists and will need the exact egress IPs and port list.

3) Firewall constraints: We terminate TLS at the firewall but do not perform TLS interception. We do have an outbound proxy that requires IP allowlisting; no proxy auth.

Procurement note: We aim to have PO issuance by the week of Dec 13 if contract redlines are minimal. I copied procure@ledgerai.com for any vendor paperwork.

Attaching: procurement_PO_placeholder.pdf (we will replace with formal PO).

Sam Turner
Head of Cloud Infrastructure, LedgerAI
sam.turner@ledgerai.com | +1 (650) 555-0112

Subject: Re: Private deployment: next steps and network confirmation (LedgerAI)

Sam / Kimberly — Vivek here (Solutions). Quick technical follow-up and proposed mutual action plan.

Thanks for confirming PrivateLink and for Jordan's contact — Jordan, nice to e-meet you. A few clarifying items from our infra team before the kickoff: 
- Egress IPs: We have two NAT egress IPs per region for the PrivateLink service (production). Will send exact CIDRs in a follow-up email once we confirm the region (we support us-west-2, us-east-1).
- Ports: 443 outbound (TLS) is required for model inference; 443 and 4430 for health/tracing (if you opt-in to advanced observability).
- Certs: We support both customer-supplied server certs for mTLS and our standard TLS. If you require mTLS we need the cert exchange process documented (Jordan, do you have a cert manager?).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (short):
1) This week: share exact egress IP/CIDRs + ports (from Redwood). LedgerAI to confirm firewall ticket.
2) Week of Dec 6: 30-min Tech kickoff (Redwood infra + Ledger NetOps) to validate PrivateLink DNS and cert expectations.
3) Week of Dec 13: Contract finalization / PO.
4) Target Jan 10: Pilot window (2 weeks).

Jordan — can you confirm whether your team needs the PrivateLink DNS names (we can pre-provide) or whether you'll rely purely on IP allowlisting? Also, any specific time windows for a 30-min kickoff this week?

Cheers, Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (206) 555-0144
